title: Quantum algorithm for the nonlinear Schrödinger equation via the Lax-pair scattering
summary: The nonlinear Schrödinger equation (NLSE) governs a broad class of wave phenomena, including deep-water waves, quantum turbulence, and solitons. The multiscale spatiotemporal coupling inherent in these systems imposes severe computational bottlenecks on classical high-fidelity numerical simulations. While quantum computing offers the potential for exponential speedup, its unitary dynamics pose a fundamental challenge to solve the NLSE.
